about: Caption styles for the in-scene caption overlay (scripts/render/captions.js). Starting points, never fences: a build may bend any of these or invent its own style; only the OUTCOME rules apply (scripts/render/caption_marks.py validate_style): font_px >= 28 at 1080p and never shrunk (overflow is segmented or truncated with an ellipsis and recorded as a finding), at most 2 lines of at most 42 characters, the box inside the safe area, and caption text >= 4.5:1 against what is behind it. Colours are ROLES resolved from the active design system, never hex values. Marks (good/bad/key and any the kit declares) come from the active kit's caption_style.marks.

fields.font_px: type size at 1920x1080; scaled by height/1080 at other sizes; never below 28 at 1080p
fields.position: anchor top|middle|bottom, align left|center|right, inset_pct from the anchored edges, width_pct of the frame
fields.scrim: panel behind the text: role + alpha + radius_px + pad_px (null for none)
fields.outline: glyph outline when there is no scrim: role + px
fields.highlight: current-word treatment: mode none|word|phrase, style box|underline|color|weight, role; uses the alignment word timings window.__C8_WORDS__ ({lines:[{name,start,end,words:[{w,start,end,i}]}]}: line by name or time, word by index) when present and matching, else a character-proportional estimate across the cue
fields.reveal: all (whole cue at once) | word (words appear as spoken)

styles.name: Boxed karaoke, current word highlighted
use_when: language-dense beats where the eye should track the voice

styles.name: Minimal outline, no panel
use_when: when a panel would cover the subject

styles.name: Centre title card
use_when: the one sentence a beat exists for

styles.name: Side note beside the subject
use_when: annotating a diagram that fills the left of the frame
a remark that should not cover the subject

styles.name: Big and bold, for young viewers
Console line, lower left
